title: What If Asta Was Reborn With All His Memories And Anti-Magic? — Part 1

ASTA.description: Sharp, quiet, strategic. An old soul in a child's body, dry humour, never screechy.

LIEBE.description: Raspy, sarcastic, guarded devil sealed in the five-leaf grimoire.

YAMI.description: Gravelly deadpan captain of the Black Bulls.

SISTER_LILY.description: Gentle, sweet nun with a dangerous right fist.

NOELLE.description: Proud, sharp-tongued royal of House Silva. Haughty and flustered on the surface, secretly desperate to prove herself.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The sky tears open over the final battlefield. Red light, black light, and a whole world holding its breath.

visuals.query: anime still of the sky ripping open with red and black light over the final battlefield, Lucifero's power overhead
Lucifero's black and red power looming in the torn sky above the battlefield

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Asta! Wake up! Asta!

visuals.query: Liebe screaming Asta's name, wide-eyed, manga panel or anime still of his panicked face

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Asta falls, and the world goes silent. Then church bells. Cold sheets. Small, trembling hands. Same bed, same church, same cracked ceiling.

visuals.query: Asta in black form falling through the sky, sword slipping from his hand, final battle
tiny child hands clutching a blanket, Hage church bedroom, early morning light
the Hage church exterior at dawn, small stone chapel in the Forsaken Realm

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Asta was never supposed to have magic. He was supposed to wait fifteen years in the dirt for a miracle.

visuals.query: Asta standing empty-handed at the grimoire ceremony while the crowd laughs at him
young Asta alone on a Hage village road looking up at the sky, dust in the air
child Asta small before the giant demon skull and the First Wizard King statue above Hage

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: What if he remembered everything? The Spade raid. The betrayals. Every name, every face, every grave.

visuals.query: close-up of a child Asta's eyes turning hard and ancient, determined stare
the Spade Kingdom raid on the Royal Capital, Dark Triad above burning rooftops

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And the brother sealed inside the wall of Hage's tower. All of it, in the head of a six year old boy.

visuals.query: the filthy five-leaf grimoire lying in the grimoire tower, dark and glowing faintly
six-year-old Asta staring straight at the camera with a grown man's resolve

chapters.title: THE BOY WHO READ THE WIND

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The wind in Hage comes down off the demon skull, and nobody ever thinks twice about it. Asta thinks about nothing else. He stands at the church fence, eyes closed, and feels the air lean.

visuals.query: the giant demon skull above Hage village with the First Wizard King statue, wind in the grass
Hage village rooftops and dirt road in soft daylight
young Asta standing at the church fence with eyes shut, hair stirring in the wind

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Ki. The breath and the heartbeat of the world. A body with no magic can still learn to hear it.

visuals.query: young Asta concentrating, eyes closed, calm face, early training
grass bending in a breeze across the village fields

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The air shifts. Three seconds later, Yuno's gust slams the laundry line, and every sheet snaps.

visuals.query: young Yuno casting wind magic, a gust whipping laundry on the church line
young Asta opening his eyes and smiling slightly as sheets snap behind him

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: Hey. You looked at the sheets before my wind even moved. How?

visuals.query: young Yuno frowning at Asta, puzzled

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Heh. Lucky guess.

visuals.query: young Asta shrugging with an innocent face

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Yuno is six, and still a crybaby. Last time, Asta mocked him for it. This time, he hands him a handkerchief.

visuals.query: young Yuno crying with young Asta beside him in Hage, church yard
young Asta offering a cloth, gentle expression

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: I wasn't crying! It was the wind, okay?

visuals.query: young Yuno rubbing his eyes, denying everything

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Sure it was. Totally the wind.

visuals.query: young Asta with a flat knowing half-smile

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: Why are you being nice to me? It's weird. What do you want?

visuals.query: young Yuno wiping his tears, suspicious look at Asta

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Call it an investment.

visuals.query: young Asta with a flat knowing half-smile

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: It confuses everyone. The loudest kid in Hage has gone quiet, and he watches everything. Then Sister Lily crosses the yard, and an old habit wakes up on its own.

visuals.query: Father Orsi and Sister Lily watching the orphans in the church yard, puzzled
young Asta sitting apart on the church steps, watching
Sister Lily walking across the church yard with a gentle smile

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Sister Lily, marry me!

visuals.query: young Asta proposing to Sister Lily with hands clasped, comedic

beats.speaker: SISTER_LILY
beats.text: Oh, Asta. You know the rule.

visuals.query: Sister Lily smiling sweetly while raising a water-wrapped fist

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He feels her weight shift a heartbeat early. And for the first time in history, Asta steps aside.

visuals.query: Sister Lily's water magic fist swinging forward in a rush of water
young Asta sidestepping neatly with a calm face

beats.speaker: FATHER_ORSI
beats.text: It missed! Lily's fist missed! That's never happened!

visuals.query: Father Orsi wide-eyed and sweating in shock, comedic panic

beats.speaker: SISTER_LILY
beats.text: Oh my. Asta, you're growing up so fast.

visuals.query: Sister Lily smiling sweetly with a faint dark aura

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: At seven, Asta asks Yuno for a blindfold, then tells him to throw everything he has. Wind blades. Pebbles. A gust meant to knock him flat. He slips between them like smoke.

visuals.query: young Asta tying a blindfold over his eyes while young Yuno watches skeptically
young Yuno hurling wind magic across a field, blades of air flying
blindfolded young Asta ducking and slipping past a gust of wind

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: How did you know?

visuals.query: young Yuno breathing hard, wide-eyed in disbelief

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Throw harder. You breathe in right before you cast.

visuals.query: blindfolded young Asta waiting calmly, head tilted
young Asta pulling off a blindfold, calm certain gaze

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Yuno goes very still. He isn't used to being the one who's behind. And he hates how it feels.

visuals.query: young Yuno's expression hardening with competitive fire

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: Then I'll learn not to. I'll be Wizard King first, you'll see.

visuals.query: young Yuno declaring his goal, wind lifting his hair

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Try it. I'm still beating you there, Yuno.

visuals.query: young Asta grinning with fist clenched, facing Yuno

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Season after season, he trains the only thing nobody can take from him. And every night, he climbs to the roof and looks at the grimoire tower.

visuals.query: young Asta training hard in a Hage field, sweat and swinging a heavy bar
seasons passing over Hage village fields
the grimoire tower against the night sky

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Because he knows what is sleeping in its wall. And he knows exactly how long it has been waiting.

visuals.query: a cracked stone wall inside the grimoire tower, faint dark glow
the five-leaf grimoire, tattered and dark

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Age ten. Midnight. The grimoire tower is empty, and Asta knows which stone to press. He follows the draft, cold and thin, to a crack in the wall.

visuals.query: young Asta creeping through the dark grimoire tower interior at night
grimoire tower interior at night, shelves and stone
narrow crack in a stone wall in the grimoire tower with dust drifting

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Behind the cracked stone lies a filthy, tattered book. Five leaves. He's waited four years to touch it.

visuals.query: the filthy five-leaf grimoire lodged in the grimoire tower wall

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: His fingers close on the cover, and the tower vanishes. Black water. No floor, no sky. Something vast turns over in the dark, and it's hungry.

visuals.query: the five-leaf grimoire's tattered cover, dark energy beginning to leak
the black mindscape of the five-leaf grimoire, endless dark with red glow

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Chains of old black light hang from nowhere, and every single one of them is aimed at him.

visuals.query: dark chains and anti-magic energy hanging in the black mindscape

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: A magicless brat, walking right into my mouth. How convenient.

visuals.query: Liebe grinning with sharp teeth, menacing, glowing eyes in the mindscape

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Devils hate humans. I hate you most. I'll be wearing you by morning.

visuals.query: Liebe lunging forward with claws raised in the dark mindscape

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Asta doesn't raise a hand. He just looks up, the way you look at someone you've missed for years.

visuals.query: small figure of Asta standing calm before the huge devil in the black mindscape

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Why aren't you scared, boy?

visuals.query: Liebe leaning close, eyes narrowed, suspicious

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Your name is Liebe.

visuals.query: young Asta looking up with steady, gentle eyes
Liebe frozen, eyes widening in disbelief

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Who told you that? Nobody knows that name.

visuals.query: Liebe's face twisted with suspicion and fear

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Your mother named you. Her name was Licita.

visuals.query: young Asta speaking softly, steady eyes
Licita smiling softly, holding baby Liebe, manga panel or flashback still

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Don't. Don't say that name.

visuals.query: Liebe baring his teeth, eyes wet, fury and grief

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Licita. She held you until the very end.

visuals.query: young Asta speaking gently with sorrowful eyes
Licita embracing Liebe in his flashback of her death

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: I said don't!

visuals.query: Liebe lunging with claws, rage at its peak

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The dark shudders. Claws that were closing stop, trembling, an inch from his face.

visuals.query: devil claws stopped inches from a child's face
anti-magic aura crackling and fading

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: She died. She sealed me in this filth and died. What do you know?

visuals.query: Liebe with his head bowed, claws shaking, grief

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: That she chose you. Every single time.

visuals.query: young Asta's calm and tearful face, quiet resolve

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Nothing. For a long time, only the sound of something enormous trying not to breathe.

visuals.query: the black mindscape gone still, drifting embers
Liebe lowering his head in silence

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: She was my mother too.

visuals.query: young Asta's eyes glistening, raw honesty

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: No. That's not possible.

visuals.query: Liebe's face crumbling, rage fading into shock

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: She left me at a church door so I'd live.

visuals.query: baby Asta left at the church door in Hage, flashback

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Who are you?

visuals.query: Liebe asking quietly, defenses gone

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Your brother. And I'm late.

visuals.query: young Asta offering a faint smile, eyes soft
Liebe stunned, mouth open

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Last time, I was fifteen years late.

visuals.query: young Asta's haunted eyes, years of grief

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Last time? What does that mean?

visuals.query: Liebe frowning, suspicious and confused

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Later. First, let me sit down.

visuals.query: young Asta sitting down in the dark mindscape, relaxed

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: What do you want from me?

visuals.query: Liebe watching Asta warily

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Just to sit here a minute. With my brother.

visuals.query: Asta and Liebe side by side in the dark mindscape, quiet

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Tch. You're the dumbest human I've ever met.

visuals.query: Liebe turning his face away, rough grin hiding tears

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Probably. I've been told.

visuals.query: young Asta smiling warmly

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Outside, the dawn bell rolls over Hage. Asta climbs out of the tower with dust on his hands and no fear at all. Behind him, in the wall, a devil lies still. Not trapped. Waiting.

visuals.query: grimoire tower at dawn over Hage, soft light
Hage village waking at sunrise
the five-leaf grimoire in its wall, faint glow pulsing

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Five years. By day, Ki footwork until his legs shake. By night, he sits against the tower wall and talks. About bread. About Yuno. About the sky.

visuals.query: teen Asta running and dodging through a Hage field, training
Asta sitting against the grimoire tower wall at night talking quietly
grimoire tower against a starry night sky

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Today Yuno tried to cut a tree. The tree won.

visuals.query: Asta sitting against the tower wall, chuckling in the dark

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: You're boring me to death, human. Bread? Seriously, bread?

visuals.query: Liebe rolling his eyes, bored smirk

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Then why do you keep answering?

visuals.query: Asta grinning with eyes closed against the stone wall

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: I'm stuck in a book. Echoes are all I get.

visuals.query: Liebe looking away, hiding embarrassment

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The book won't open before the ceremony. So Asta waits, again. But this time, he isn't waiting alone.

visuals.query: the five-leaf grimoire sealed in the tower wall, quiet
Asta at the church window at dusk, waiting

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Make the contract. Master and servant. That's how it works.

visuals.query: Liebe holding out a clawed hand offering a devil contract

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: No. Equals, or nothing.

visuals.query: Asta shaking his head with a firm, steady look

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Tch. Fine. Equals. Whatever. Like I care.

visuals.query: Liebe turning away with an embarrassed scowl

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Fifteen. The tower hall is packed with trembling children. Yuno steps forward, and a four-leaf grimoire answers him.

visuals.query: Yuno receiving the four-leaf grimoire in the grimoire tower, golden light
the crowd in the tower hall gasping at the four-leaf grimoire

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then it's Asta's turn. Nothing. No light, no book. Only laughter, rolling across the hall.

visuals.query: Asta standing with empty hands as the crowd laughs at him in the grimoire tower

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: They're laughing at you. Doesn't that bother you?

visuals.query: Liebe watching through the grimoire's dark, needling

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Not anymore. I know how this ends.

visuals.query: Asta with a quiet, assured look amid the crowd

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Exactly as before, down to the last giggle. And this time, Asta smiles. On the road home, Revchi steps out of the trees, chains hissing at his wrists. He wants Yuno's grimoire.

visuals.query: Asta with a calm smile despite the laughter around him
Revchi the former Magic Knight stepping out with chain magic coiling
Yuno clutching the four-leaf grimoire on the road

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He doesn't notice the magicless boy who's already standing behind him. Nobody ever does.

visuals.query: Asta standing calmly behind Revchi on the road

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Revchi. Chain Magic. Thrown out of the Purple Orcas in disgrace.

visuals.query: Asta with a cold, steady stare

beats.speaker: REVCHI
beats.text: Magicless trash like you has no right to—

visuals.query: Revchi sneering with a vicious grin

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Skip it.

visuals.query: Asta cutting him off with a flat unimpressed look

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Behind them the tower groans. A crack tears up the wall, and the stone gives way. The five-leaf grimoire rips itself free and tears across the sky, straight for his hand.

visuals.query: the grimoire tower cracking open, rubble falling
the five-leaf grimoire flying through the sky streaming dark light
Asta reaching out as the grimoire flies into his hand

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Hurry up, partner. I'm getting bored over here.

visuals.query: Liebe grinning wide, eager for a fight

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Demon-Slayer Sword drops into his hand. One swing. Revchi's chains don't break. They simply stop existing.

visuals.query: Asta swinging the Demon-Slayer Sword, black anti-magic aura
Revchi staring in shock as his chains vanish into nothing
the Demon-Slayer Sword blade, dark and still

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Ha! Now that's what I'm talking about.

visuals.query: Liebe grinning wickedly, delighted

beats.speaker: REVCHI
beats.text: My chains! What did you do to my chains?

visuals.query: Revchi trembling, staring at his empty hands

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: You've been hiding something since we were six.

visuals.query: Yuno with the four-leaf grimoire, studying Asta carefully

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Only a few things.

visuals.query: Asta shouldering the sword with a cheeky grin

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: Fine. Keep your secrets. Just leave me an enemy next time.

visuals.query: Yuno with a dry sidelong stare

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Then be faster, Yuno.

visuals.query: Asta and Yuno facing each other, rivals smirking

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: Hmph. I was letting you have it.

visuals.query: Yuno smirking at Asta, rivalry in the air

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Royal Capital. Banners, towers, ten thousand voices. Every hopeful in the kingdom, packed into one arena.

visuals.query: the Royal Capital skyline, banners and towers in daylight
Magic Knights Entrance Exam arena packed with applicants

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And across the field, a man in black, cigarette burning low. Yami Sukehiro. Alive. Asta's breath catches. He remembers losing that man, and now he's standing right there, yawning.

visuals.query: Yami Sukehiro standing in black with a cigarette, calm
Asta staring with wide eyes and trembling breath
Asta fighting back emotion while looking at Yami across the arena

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.text: Kid. Why are you looking at me like I died?

visuals.query: Yami squinting with a deadpan unimpressed look

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: No reason. Really.

visuals.query: Asta looking away, forced calm

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.text: Stop it. You're creeping me out, kid.

visuals.query: Yami frowning, cigarette between his teeth

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Sorry. Long story.

visuals.query: Asta rubbing the back of his neck sheepishly

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: His match lasts one breath. Asta reads the swing, steps inside it, and ends it with one move.

visuals.query: Asta striking down an opponent with a single move in the arena
the stunned arena crowd falling silent

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.text: Not bad, brat. Where'd you learn that?

visuals.query: Yami eyeing Asta with sharp interest

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: A very patient teacher.

visuals.query: Asta holding back a smile

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.text: Tch. Whoever he is, he owes me a drink.

visuals.query: Yami smirking with a cigarette

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The arena goes silent. Then one hand goes up. Then another. Hands that never went up for him before.

visuals.query: the captains raising their hands in the viewing box
captains' hands rising one after another over the arena

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Noelle Silva. Last time, her water magic ran wild for months, and Asta watched her become the pride of her house. Today she's at the edge of the field, spilling water over her own boots.

visuals.query: Noelle Silva standing alone at the edge of the exam arena, water spilling uncontrolled from her wand
Noelle's frustrated face as her water magic bursts out of control and soaks her

beats.speaker: NOELLE
beats.text: Eyes off, commoner. My magic is just having a bad day.

visuals.query: Noelle Silva glaring proudly, arms crossed, soaked and embarrassed

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: It's not a bad day. You're aiming at your family's approval. Aim at something you want to protect.

visuals.query: Asta speaking calmly and seriously to Noelle in the arena
Noelle's eyes softening, listening despite herself

beats.speaker: NOELLE
beats.text: Don't get the wrong idea. I didn't ask a commoner for advice.

visuals.query: Noelle looking away with a proud, tsundere scowl

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: But her fingers close anyway. She thinks of nothing she has to win, only of what she'd stand in front of. And the water rises in her bare palm. No wand. Round, and perfectly still.

visuals.query: Noelle's open palm with a perfect sphere of water floating above it
Noelle staring in amazement at the steady water sphere

beats.speaker: NOELLE
beats.text: It's holding. It's actually holding. It's listening to me.

visuals.query: Noelle's wide, wondering eyes reflected in the water sphere

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Yeah. That one's all yours.

visuals.query: Asta smiling softly in the arena

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.text: Listen, brat. The Black Bulls aren't exactly—

visuals.query: Yami stepping forward to speak to Asta

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Black Bulls. I'm in. Sign me up.

visuals.query: Asta answering instantly with a bright resolute grin

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Across the arena, Yuno signs with the Golden Dawn. His wind moves before he breathes in. That's what years of chasing one boy will do.

visuals.query: Yuno choosing the Golden Dawn, calm and proud
Asta and Yuno looking at each other across the arena

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: Don't fall behind, Asta.

visuals.query: Yuno calling across the arena with a faint smirk

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Don't trip, Yuno.

visuals.query: Asta grinning back across the arena

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On the arena floor, Asta closes his eyes. The captains' box becomes a map of heartbeats.

visuals.query: Asta closing his eyes to sense, calm focus
captains in the viewing box above the arena

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He knows exactly where to look. William Vangeance sits very still, and inside him there are two Ki. Two lives. One body.

visuals.query: William Vangeance with Patolli's presence behind his eyes
William Vangeance seated calmly among the captains

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: But this time, someone feels it back. Behind William's calm eyes, Patolli turns, slow as a blade, toward the boy who is looking.

visuals.query: William Vangeance with the second presence, Patolli, looking out through his eyes
Asta's eyes snapping open, realizing he has been noticed

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Above them all, Wizard King Julius Novachrono tilts his head. He's watching the boy.

visuals.query: Wizard King Julius Novachrono watching from his seat, tilting his head

beats.speaker: JULIUS
beats.text: Oh? This boy's time doesn't move like ours. Someone has wound it back. How interesting.

visuals.query: Julius with a bright, unsettling smile, Time Magic glowing
Julius's eyes glinting beneath his hat brim

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: That night, on the road to the Black Bulls' hideout, the air above the trees folds open like torn cloth. White-robed mages step out, one after another. The Eye of the Midnight Sun. Months early.

visuals.query: a dark forest road at night leading toward the Black Bulls' hideout
the night sky tearing open into a spatial rift above the trees
white-robed Eye of the Midnight Sun mages stepping out of a rift at night

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: None of this happened in his first life. Asta stops walking. The future he memorized has just stopped being true.

visuals.query: Asta frozen on a night road, eyes wide with realization
the Eye of the Midnight Sun mages spreading out in the dark

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: In Part Two, the Eye of the Midnight Sun comes for the one boy who knows exactly how this story ends.

visuals.query: Asta on a dark road at night looking up at the sky
Eye of the Midnight Sun mages closing in at night
the Black Bulls' hideout glowing against the night sky

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Wind's changed. Fine. Then I'll learn to read it all over again.

visuals.query: Asta's face lit by moonlight on a night road, calm and resolute
